name: Hi, Welcome to Froggy's!
source:
Tired of your boring day job? Do you need new opportunities and an unlimited supply of cheap coffee? Well, you're in luck, because your local Froggy's store is looking for a talented and hardworking person for the night shift!

"Hi, Welcome to Froggy's" is a management game where you serve customers and take care of one of many Froggy's stores in a big and strange city. Scanning products, making coffee and much more awaits you!

You play as Maelle, and just like you she has a lot to learn in this weird job, but I'm sure you two can do it! Ribbit! 🐸

[from [url=https://nighten.itch.io/hi-welcome-to-froggys-demo]itch.io[/url]]
